# PeterWolf’s Planes 

![planes mod banner ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/McTtzw3T/images/b10e03807ec6d841ec4c05ee0046baef2c4a1baa.png)

## Overview
Peter Wolf’s Planes adds a fully‑steerable biplane to Minecraft, bringing a lightweight, vintage‑style aviation experience to the game. The mod introduces realistic flight physics, speed‑dependent control surfaces, a functional HUD, and a polished visual presentation (custom icon and ModMenu banner).

## Features
* Steerable Biplane Entity – Fly a biplane that responds to mouse look (pitch & roll) and keyboard A/D for yaw/rudder.
* Speed‑Dependent Controls – Control surface effectiveness scales with forward speed; at a standstill the plane is unresponsive, and responsiveness ramps up linearly as you accelerate.
* Aerodynamic Lift Tuning – Lift is calibrated to overcome gravity at roughly 35 km/h (≈ 0.486 blocks/tick), providing a smooth take‑off and realistic stall behavior.
* Improved Gliding Physics – Reduced drag at low throttle and enhanced lift allow graceful glides and energy exchange (climbing slows the plane, diving speeds it up).
* Larger Landing‑Gear Wheels – Wheels are now 4 × 10 × 10 blocks, with custom textures for a sturdier ground stance and better visual appeal.
* Cockpit HUD – A glass‑morphic overlay shows current speed (m/s & km/h), altitude, vertical speed (color‑coded), and throttle/brake status.

## Installation
1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 26.2 (or newer) and the Fabric API.
2. Download the latest peterwolfs_planes-*.jar from Modrinth.
3. Place the JAR file into your mods/ folder.
4. Launch Minecraft – the biplane item appears in the Creative tab under Peter Wolf’s Planes and can be crafted or given via commands.

## Usage
* Equip the Plane item and right‑click to mount.
* Throttle: Use the assigned key (default W/S). Negative throttle triggers wheel brakes on the ground.
* Steering: Move the mouse to control pitch (up/down) and roll (left/right). Yaw is assisted by a small rudder mix.
* HUD: Automatically appears while riding; press H to toggle.
